newsitem.title: USA: Calif. Governor signs debt affordability measure.
newsitem.headline: Calif. Governor signs debt affordability measure.

text.p: California Gov. Pete Wilson signed legislation to help lawmakers evaluate the state's bonding needs, a Wilson spokesman said on Tuesday.

Senate Bill 2009, sponsored by state Treasurer Matt Fong, would require the state Treasurer to annually prepare a debt affordability report for the governor and the state Legislature that would be used as a tool for evaluating and establishing priorities among the state's bonding needs.

The report would contain prospective information regarding the rating and market of California bonds, current trends in the bond market, information on the buyers of state bonds, and the amount of outstanding debt supported by the general fund.
Fong had urged Wilson to sign the measure, arguing that it would give the governor and Legislature a proactive tool for debt management purposes.
